description: Circle CCTP V2 USDC among 24 EVM networks (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet since 2026-11-23/24; Avalanche, Polygon, HyperEVM, Unichain, Linea, Sonic, World Chain, Monad, Sei, Ink, Arc and nine more since 2026-11-24), counted from ASPERN’s stored index, each route `covered` from when it was first read. COUNT and VOLUME are two figures: `transfers` (Tx) and volume in USD (`amountUsd`: USDC moved times the day’s USDC price from our stablecoin peg readings, par where none, `usd` says which), with the raw USDC (`amount` native, `amountFormatted`) beside it; the burn counted once per transfer. `directions`: every route with a transfer in the window, largest USD first, with perDay, completed, median and p90 seconds burn to mint overall and by finality (confirmed = fast, finalized = standard) and `medianSays`. `matrix`: networks by volume, source x destination cells for every route (null on the diagonal, `covered` false before the route is read). `scale`: ONE USD scale for every direction. `outside`: burns to domains the index does not read (Solana, Stellar, Starknet, Sui, Aptos, EDGE), counted per source, not stored. `parties`: known_agent (ERC-8004 registrant, holder or agentWallet, ACP client or provider, x402 payer), contract_other (a named contract) or unclassified, which is NOT human. `index.state`: read, not_yet_read or unavailable (never zero traffic). Never claims the addresses share an owner, that an AI agent acted, or that anything was autonomous. One transfer: cross_chain_trace. FREE.

days.description: Window in days, default 30, at most 365.

name: cross_chain_stats

agentsVsRest.description: Agents against everyone else over the same window (added 2026-11-25): state (read | not_yet_read | unavailable), matchedOn (sender_or_recipient: the burn message sender, who called depositForBurn, or the mintRecipient), definition (agent-linked = an address registered as an agent on ERC-8004 or ACP, or seen paying an x402 seller; a registration is not proof that software acted on its own; x402 payees are not counted), total (transfers, amountUsd, amountUsdFormatted), agents and rest (each transfers, amount native USDC, amountFormatted, amountUsd, amountUsdFormatted, shareOfAmountUsd, shareOfTransfers; null unless state is read, never zero for an unread split; rest is the total less the agents, so the two add up to totals), says.

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

directions.description: Routes with at least one transfer, largest USD first: route, label, sourceNetwork, destinationNetwork, covered (from, through, messages, notYetSettled), transfers (Tx), completed, amount (native USDC), amountFormatted, amountUsd, amountUsdFormatted, perDay [day, transfers, completed, amount, amountFormatted, usdcPrice, priceBasis (peg_reading | assumed_par), amountUsd, byParty], medianSeconds, p90Seconds, medianSays, byFinality [finality, completed, medianSeconds, p90Seconds], parties (per class: transfers, amount, amountFormatted, amountUsd, shareOfAmount, shareOfTransfers).

index.description: state (read | not_yet_read | unavailable), says, readSince, job (enabled, everyMinutes, lastRunAt; null when unread) and cadenceSays.

matrix.description: order, networks (rows and columns, by USD volume sent plus received), totals per network (sentTransfers, sentUsd, receivedTransfers, receivedUsd), rows: per source network, cells per destination (route, transfers, amount native, amountFormatted, amountUsd, covered; null on the diagonal); maxTransfers, maxAmountUsd and maxAmount, the one scale for shading the grid.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

networks.description: Every network the index reads: network, label, CCTP domain.

notClaimed.description: What no figure here establishes: same owner, an AI agent, autonomy, same coins.

outside.description: Burns to CCTP domains the index does not read, counted not stored: state, transfers, amountUsd, bySource [network, transfers, amount, amountFormatted, amountUsd, byDomain [domain, name, transfers]], says.

parties.description: state (read | not_yet_read | unavailable), says, labels, means, totals per class (transfers, amount, amountFormatted, amountUsd, shareOfAmount, shareOfTransfers; null unless read), addresses (total and per class), evidence (addresses per kind), evidenceSays, basis.

routes.description: total, withTransfers, withoutTransfer (read, none in the window), notReadYet.

says.description: The largest routes by USD, each as Tx and USD ("base->ethereum: 638 Tx, $48.2M"), how many more, and how volume is valued; or why there are no figures.

scale.description: shared (true), unit (usd), maxDayAmountUsd, maxDayAmountUsdFormatted, maxDayAmount (native USDC of that day), maxDayAmountFormatted, maxDayTransfers, says: one scale for every direction.

totals.description: Every direction together: transfers, amount (native), amountFormatted, amountUsd, amountUsdFormatted.

usd.description: How volume is valued: means, source (the stablecoin peg readings), daysPriced, daysAssumedPar, says.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

window.description: from, through and days: every UTC day of the window, oldest first.

title: Cross-chain statistics (CCTP V2, 24 networks)
